title: Modular City stack vs. fragmented city stack
pricing_note: Illustrative planning ranges for a demonstration scenario. Replace with actual invoices, staff costs, and procurement quotes before making budget decisions.

totals.existing_stack: $150k–$760k / year across software, hosting, support, and integrations
totals.modular_city_stack: $3k–$40k / year for hosting, monitoring, automation, and optional managed support

existing_stack.tools: Commercial CMS, page-builder plugins, custom theme, vendor support
existing_stack.features: Pages, departments, news, service pages, documents
existing_stack.risk: Content and data often drift apart

modular_city_stack.tools: Jekyll static site, structured data files, Git-based workflow
modular_city_stack.features: Pages generated from data, civic-data.json, service catalog, reusable templates

existing_stack.tools: Agenda management platform plus PDF packets
existing_stack.features: Meeting notices, agenda packets, minutes, video links
existing_stack.risk: Agenda items become locked in PDFs

modular_city_stack.tools: Public bodies, meetings, agendas, and agenda-items JSON
modular_city_stack.features: Filterable meeting archive, machine-readable agenda items, body links
modular_city_stack.risk: Needs import path from clerk workflow

existing_stack.tools: CMS calendar module, embedded calendar, or third-party events tool
existing_stack.risk: Events can diverge from meeting notices

modular_city_stack.tools: JSON calendar data plus iCalendar feed
modular_city_stack.features: Static pages, ICS subscription, reusable event records

existing_stack.tools: PDF reports, spreadsheet exports, open-data portal, analytics dashboards
existing_stack.features: Budgets, performance reports, documents, data downloads
existing_stack.risk: Reports are hard to reuse across systems

modular_city_stack.tools: DCAT-US data.json, JSON exports, seed datasets, static report pages
modular_city_stack.features: Machine-readable catalogs, reproducible demo data, linkable source files

existing_stack.tools: CRM, mobile reporting app, routing rules, email inboxes
existing_stack.features: Issue intake, assignment, status updates, reporting
existing_stack.risk: Service catalog and request taxonomy may be separate

modular_city_stack.tools: Open311 service list, static 311 portal, future request API
modular_city_stack.features: Request-type catalog, demo local persistence, status tracking prototype

existing_stack.tools: Form builder, survey tool, email notifications, spreadsheets
existing_stack.features: Service feedback, contact forms, request triage
existing_stack.risk: Feedback often lacks service ownership context

modular_city_stack.features: Service ownership, feedback attachment points, future form sync

existing_stack.tools: Search, accessibility scanner, hosting, CDN, analytics, translation, document storage
existing_stack.risk: Many renewals and disconnected admin surfaces

modular_city_stack.tools: Static hosting, CI checks, open source dependencies, optional monitoring
modular_city_stack.features: Lower operating surface, fewer runtime services, source-controlled changes
modular_city_stack.risk: Some enterprise workflows may still need external systems
